elements.name: Select and clears recent rows using the header checkbox

steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
several recent documents are displayed in List View
the user checks the list header checkbox
all visible recent-document rows are checked and highlighted
Open Selected and Remove Selected appear above the list
the user clears one visible row's checkbox
that row is unchecked while the other visible rows remain checked
the header checkbox shows a partial selection
the user activates the partially selected header checkbox
all visible recent-document rows are checked again
the user clears the header checkbox
the visible recent-document rows are unchecked
Open Selected and Remove Selected are no longer displayed above the list
